description: Permanently deletes a prepared message draft. IRREVERSIBLE. messageId and draftRevision identify the exact DRAFT revision, as returned when the draft was saved or shown in a thread's messages. Only drafts can be discarded; sent and received messages are not affected. Discarding an id that is not a draft is a safe no-op that reports no draft found.

draftRevision.description: Opaque revision of the draft, as returned when it was saved

messageId.description: Id of the draft message to discard

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: discard_message_draft
title: Discard message draft
